author: GamingBolt
description:
Armageddon has finally hit Xbox. After weeks of rumored mass layoffs, CEO Asha Sharma revealed the full extent of the damage: 3,200 layoffs. The “most significant restructure in Xbox history,” as she calls it, involves 1,600 employees being laid off today and another 1,600 impacted over the next 12 months. 

Yes, Microsoft itself announced 4,800 total layoffs, meaning another 1,600 employees are gone from other areas.
title: Xbox Is Cutting 3200 Jobs, PlayStation Is Destroying Its Goodwill - Gaming Is COOKED

author: GamingBolt
description:
Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced and Shadows have a lot in common, as they are successive releases in the Assassin’s Creed franchise. The former is more than just a visual remaster of a beloved experience, while the latter is a take on the franchise formula that fans had long wished for and which was well-received thanks to its depiction of Japan.

Of course, their differences are equally important, stemming from fundamentally different approaches to the franchise’s premise and formula. But which approach could best usher in new highs for Assassin’s Creed? We’ve given that a lot of thought, and there’s a clear answer despite how close the two games are. Join us for an interesting look into what makes these two very solid games tick.
title: Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced vs. Shadows - Is Classic AC Gameplay The Better?

author: GamingBolt
description:
2026 is bringing a lot of games to the table after a very strong first half, and many of those titles are going to have to battle it out in a release calendar that’s going to enable a lot of competition. Of course, there’s the impending storm that GTA 6 is sure to bring, but each of these games and their studios, Rockstar included, are carrying the weight of some very heavy expectations. 

Irrespective of whether they have what it takes to meet them, we’ve been thinking about what it is that has made these titles earn the hype that they have managed. Of course, we’re here to tell you all about it, so join us as we explore what the pressure is on for these games, and why each one needs to succeed.
title: 10 BIG Upcoming Games With The Most To PROVE
